jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Team**
------------------

Equipment Monitoring (EM) is Motive's connected-asset product line, covering asset gateways, beacons, and environmental and door sensors. EM is one of Motive's high-growth business lines, and we have an ambitious roadmap to execute. The EM team owns the end-to-end customer experience, from the device to the cloud, web, and mobile software customers use every day.

**About the Role**
------------------

As the Cloud Software TPM for Equipment Monitoring, you will own the end-to-end delivery of EM programs across cloud software (backend, frontend, and mobile), from quarterly planning and sprint execution through customer launch and adoption. Most EM projects combine embedded, IoT, backend, and frontend work, and you will make sure those pieces come together into one cohesive plan with clear owners, milestones, and dependencies.

You will be accountable for the customer deliverables, release readiness, and measurable business outcomes of each program. Where a program involves hardware, firmware, or embedded work, you will partner closely with the hardware org TPM and embedded counterparts to work out dependencies and stay in sync on timelines and readiness, while driving the overall plan through to launch. Your ownership and delivery directly shape EM's impact on customers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Plan:** Partner with EM Product and Engineering to turn quarterly and half-year roadmaps into detailed cloud software project plans with milestones, owners, measurable customer and business outcomes, and risks.
* **Connect the pieces:** Track cross-team dependencies for each project across embedded, hardware, IoT/Platform, Product Ops, PMM, Design, and Support, partnering closely with the hardware org TPM on devices and international rollouts so projects don't stall in the gaps between teams and customer commitments are met.
* **Own end-to-end delivery:** Be accountable for each program from kickoff through customer launch and adoption, tracking milestones across concurrent programs, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early (scope, quality, and timeline), and driving decisions with stakeholders and leadership to keep delivery on track. Use customer feedback and support signals to close the loop after launch.
* **Communicate:** Maintain a single source of truth for program status, share weekly updates, and report program health, risks, and outcomes in monthly and quarterly business reviews, translating technical detail into business impact.
* **Run the operating rhythm:** Facilitate sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and demos for EM cloud engineering, and drive release-readiness checkpoints so quality risks surface before launch.
* **Improve how we work:** Run intake and triage for ad-hoc requests, fix recurring execution gaps with durable solutions, and lead quarter- and project-level retrospectives.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, with the technical fluency to engage credibly with engineers on architecture, tradeoffs, and delivery risks; a technical degree or equivalent experience is recommended.
* Proven track record leading large, ambiguous, multi-team cloud software programs (backend, web, mobile) with significant cross-team dependencies and measurable customer or business impact.
* Bias for action and root-cause problem solving over administrative tracking.
* Strong organization and communication; ability to lead and coach without authority across distributed teams and to translate technical detail into clear updates for leadership.
* Ability to define and track quality and delivery metrics (for example, escaped defects, reliability, predictability, customer feedback) and turn data into an action plan.
* Comfort in a fast-paced, changing environment, building process where little exists.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools, strong knowledge of agile methods, and experience using automation (including AI tools) to keep programs visible without manual overhead for engineers.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Exposure to connected-device or IoT products (firmware release cycles, device qualification, OTA updates), which helps in partnering with hardware and embedded teams.
* CSM or PMP certification.

*Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.*

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager, Axon 911
jobs.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**About Axon 911**  
  
Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.  
  
911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

#### **Your Impact**

As a **Senior** **Technical Project Manager**, you'll lead the successful delivery of mission-critical cloud and IT deployments that power emergency communications for public safety agencies across the country. You'll oversee projects from kickoff through go-live, ensuring implementations are delivered on time while coordinating technical and operational resources across Axon 911, our partners, and our customers. Serving as the primary technical liaison, you'll work closely with engineering, product, implementation teams, and public safety stakeholders to scope technical requirements, drive cloud deployments and system integrations, and ensure seamless cutovers into production. This role requires balancing technical expertise with exceptional project leadership, building trusted relationships with customers, and delivering solutions that directly support first responders and the communities they serve when every second matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end deployment of cloud-based platforms, including system configuration, testing, and go-live support
* Collaborate with customers, partners, and internal teams to implement scalable, secure, and resilient IT solutions tailored for public safety
* Create/manage project and technical implementation plans (e.g., infrastructure readiness, data flows, failover testing)
* Coordinate with DevOps, R&D, and Solution Architects to align product capabilities with deployment requirements
* Manage expectations across stakeholders, resolve issues proactively, and ensure milestone delivery
* Facilitate system handovers to customer IT teams and lead onboarding/training where required
* Identify post-deployment support needs and optimization opportunities for add-on services

#### **What You Bring**

* PMP or CAPM certified
* Have 5+ years of experience managing global technical projects, preferably within a B2B SaaS, IT, or cloud services company
* Are experienced in leading cross-functional teams through cloud or hybrid infrastructure implementations
* Possess strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, and cloud deployment models (AWS, Azure, etc.)
* Have a proven ability to translate customer needs into actionable technical plans
* Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced startup culture and are confident interfacing with both technical and executive stakeholders
* Are open to domestic travel to support project execution and client success (up to 20% or more)

Nice-to-Haves:

* Experience with ESInet and NG911 i3-compliant technologies
* Familiarity with systems used by PSAPs or other emergency services
* Hands-on experience managing projects involving cloud-native architectures or real-time communication platforms
* Demonstrated ability using AI tools, cross-platform integrations, and innovative tools

#### **Work Location**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates who currently reside in the United States.

#### **Benefits that Benefit You**

* Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all
* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Fitness Programs
* Emotional & Mental Wellness support
* Learning & Development programs
* And yes, we have snacks in our offices

*Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.*  
  
**Pay Transparency**  
  
**Axon is a total compensation company**, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The starting base pay for this role is between $100,050.00 in the lowest geographic market and $176,000.00 in the highest geographic market. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors.
  
  
Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially, and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings, please visit www.axon.com/careers/benefits.

  

Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager - Boston
jobs.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

**Strategic Program Manager (SPM) – Join Our World-Class Team at MISUMI Americas!**

As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at MISUMI Americas, you'll partner with leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches without sacrificing quality. Acting as a trusted advisor, you'll bring deep expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every stage — from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production.

You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment teams to scope, plan, and execute complex programs, ensuring products launch on time, within budget, and at the highest quality standards. Your ability to align internal teams with customer goals will be central to delivering consistent, measurable value across the full product lifecycle.

Beyond program execution, you'll play an active role in continuous improvement — identifying opportunities to refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that make MISUMI Americas an even stronger partner for its customers.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships to deliver high-quality customer experiences that drive long-term loyalty.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with pre- & post-sale teams to ensure on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Leverage your technical expertise in engineering and manufacturing alongside strong program management skills to identify risks early, develop risk mitigation plans, and manage changes to keep projects on track.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the program, providing valuable insights and guidance to both internal teams and customers to ensure alignment and clarity.
* Monitor and report program milestones making necessary adjustments to timelines and deliverables, to meet customer expectations and maintain high-quality standards.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Facilitate regular status meetings with customers and internal teams to clearly communicate requirements, timelines, and quality standards, ensuring alignment and proactively resolving any blockers.
* All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

**Desired Traits:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering.
* 5+ years of experience managing projects/ programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and high-volume manufacturing facilities.
* Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC Machining, 3D Printing, Injection Molding, Sheet Metal Fabrication, Die Casting, or Assembly.
* Customer-Facing Experience to lead complex, consultative technical sales engagements, leveraging operational expertise to drive success.
* Strong program management, risk management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines within a structured framework.
* Proficiency in standard program management tools and software used for tracking, communication, and reporting across distributed teams.
* Self-starter, with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving problems and building deep, meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrates a focus on process optimization, service enhancement, and driving customer success.
* Passionate about learning, building solutions, and tackling challenges.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with experience working across multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.

At MISUMI Americas you will be part of an innovative team that is redefining the future of manufacturing. If you're excited by challenges, passionate about delivering customer success, and eager to continuously learn and grow, we want to hear from you!

### **Perks and Benefits**

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K plan
* Monthly Virtual Work stipend for things like food, internet, travel, pet care, health and wellness
* Parental leave programs
* Paid volunteer days
* Onboarding setup, including: standing desk, laptop, monitor, and chair, and a stipend for additional items such as headphones, blue light glasses, or any other ergonomic supplies you may want or need
* And much, much more!

Salary Range: $123,000 to $145,000 USD per year, depending upon experience

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**

We're actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Program Analyst
jobs.description:
A3 Technology, Inc. is seeking a Program Analyst to support the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Technical Operations (AJW) organizations as a member of the AJW-173 In-Service Management Team. This position requires the successful candidate to support lifecycle and in-service management activities across National Airspace System (NAS) programs, including program coordination, communications, financial tracking, and stakeholder engagement.

  

The candidate will assist in development of program products, status reporting, lifecycle documentation, and briefings supporting NAS systems and AJW portfolio management activities.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop, format, and maintain reports, briefings, correspondence, and presentations for program and organizational communication.
* Coordinate and manage meetings, including scheduling, agenda development, facilitation support, and preparation/distribution of meeting minutes.
* Perform data entry, tracking, and reporting using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Project, Teams) and Google Workspace tools.
* Maintain program files, records, and documentation repositories (including SharePoint and other collaboration platforms).
* Track administrative and programmatic actions, including correspondence and contract-related activities.
* Support travel coordination, training events, and program logistics.
* Support lifecycle management activities aligned with FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) phases, including pre- and post-In-Service Decision activities.
* Track, review, and manage program artifacts and documentation through completion and acceptance.
* Maintain awareness of program status within the NAS lifecycle and support execution of In-Service Management SOP activities.
* Assist in planning and analysis of NAS capabilities to support current and future mission needs.
* Coordinate with stakeholders including AJW In-Service Managers and Program Management Organizations (e.g., AJM).
* Support development and tracking of program schedules, milestones, and status reporting.
* Assist with risk and issue management activities, including tracking, analysis, and mitigation support.
* Conduct research, data analysis, and provide recommendations to support program decisions.
* Develop dashboards, charts, and visualizations to communicate program performance and status.
* Support lessons learned activities, stakeholder feedback sessions, and program improvement initiatives.
* Assist in financial planning activities, including budget tracking, expenditure analysis, and reconciliation reporting.
* Support development of financial reports and provide data-driven insights to management.
* Assist with lifecycle management and accountability of Government Furnished Equipment (GFE), including inventory tracking and property records.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams, program management, and stakeholders.
* Develop program communications including newsletters, updates, and stakeholder briefings.
* Support cross-organizational coordination and collaboration efforts.
* Assist in development and implementation of processes to improve program tracking and execution.
* Support SharePoint site development and maintenance (architecture, permissions, workflows, content management).
* Support tracking and processing of National Change Proposals (NCPs), including coordination and documentation.

  

**Skills Required:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree required (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in program analysis, project support, or administrative/program management roles.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to support technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Project).
* Experience with data tracking, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* US Citizenship required; must be able to obtain/maintain government clearance.

  

**Skills Preferred:**

* Prior FAA experience, particularly within Technical Operations (AJW) or NAS lifecycle support.
* Familiarity with FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS) and In-Service Management processes.
* Experience supporting program schedules, risk management, and lifecycle documentation.
* Experience with SharePoint development and administration.
* Experience with financial tracking and budget analysis.
* Experience supporting logistics, asset management, or property tracking processes.
* Familiarity with National Airspace System (NAS) programs and infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace.

  

Additionally, US Citizenship or documented proof of eligibility to work in the US is a must. Upon receiving a conditional offer of employment, candidates will undergo a Government investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for Government clearance. Verification of past employment, education and references is also required. It is imperative that candidates be either a US citizen or a current green card holder with the last 3 consecutive years as a resident of the US.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking an experienced and decisive **Program Manager (PM)** to lead the execution of a missile development and production program. In this leadership role, you will hold operational accountability for project success, ensuring that complex, multi-disciplinary engineering, testing, manufacturing, and supply chain deliverables are met on schedule, within cost constraints, and to contract specifications.

Working closely with the Program Chief Engineer, Integrated Product Team (IPT) leads, customers, and executive management, you will lead the strategic planning, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and daily execution across the entire program lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Program Execution & Lifecycle Management**

* Lead overall program execution from task award through design, development, hardware integration, production, and flight testing.
* Establish, maintain, and drive the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) aligning cross-functional engineering, procurement, and testing milestones.
* Direct program execution strategies across major formal milestones, including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), Flight Readiness Reviews (FRRs), and Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs).

**2. Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage overall program budget, cash flow, margins, and cost baselines.
* Monitor and report, and manage cost performance and schedule performance metrics.
* Author and submit formal customer financial and progress status reports.

**3. Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary operational and contractual point of contact for Project Management Offices (PMOs) and other customers.
* Lead formal program management reviews (PMRs) and executive briefings
* Manage customer expectations, scope modifications, engineering change proposals (ECPs), and contract additions.

**4. Risk Management & Cross-Functional Team Leadership**

* Establish and drive the Program Risk and Opportunity Management Board (ROMB) to proactively identify, quantify, and mitigate technical, schedule, supply chain, and financial risks.
* Partner with the Program Chief Engineer to balance technical trade-offs against schedule impacts and financial budgets.
* Oversee subcontractor management, major suppliers, and vendor deliverables in coordination with Global Supply Chain leadership.

**5. Flight Test & Range Logistics Oversight**

* Coordinate resource deployment, range access, and hardware availability for captive-carry, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL), and live-fire flight test campaigns.
* Ensure regulatory, range safety, and safety compliance across all flight operations and field deployments.

**Required Qualifications & Background**

* **Education:** B.S. in Engineering, Business Administration, Systems Management, or a related field (Formal acquisitions training and certification strongly preferred).
* **Experience:**
  + **5+ years** of direct experience as a Program Manager or Deputy PM managing complex hardware/software defense contracts.
* **Domain Mastery:**
  + Demonstrated track record managing defense development programs
  + In-depth understanding of DoW acquisition cycles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS), and defense contracting types (CPFF, FPIF, FFP).
  + Direct expertise utilizing advanced scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or Deltek Open Plan).
* **Security Clearance:** Must hold an **active US DoD Secret clearance**

**Desired Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or DAWIA Level III PM Certification.
* Prior experience managing ACAT I/II or major sub-system programs for the U.S. Department of War.
* Proven track record leading live-fire flight test programs or remote range deployments.
* Experience transitioning missile systems low-rate production.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
**About the role**

Dassian is seeking an experienced Program Manager to join our Professional Services team and lead SAP-based client programs in the Aerospace & Defense and government contracting sectors. The Program Manager is accountable for the successful delivery of each assigned program, including planning, execution, and fulfillment of all contractual commitments and deliverables, while serving as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders. In addition, the Program Manager will work with Dassian leadership and peers to help develop and apply consistent internal processes and standards for program governance, reporting, and delivery.

**What you'll do**

* Manage assigned client programs end to end: scope, schedule, resources, budget and status, including dependencies across workstreams.
* Track program budget, forecast and burn against the contract, and flag variances early.
* Maintain a register of contractual commitments for each program (SOW deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, billing events) and drive them to on-time completion.
* Run the regular cadence on your programs: weekly status reports, periodic reviews with client leadership, and tracking of risks, issues and decisions.
* Lead Dassian functional, technical and support teams, and partner/SI teams, against the program plan, often without direct authority.
* Manage scope changes through formal change requests and keep the SOW, plan and billing aligned.
* Escalate risks early to Dassian leadership and the client, with a recommended path forward.
* Contribute to the development of consistent Dassian processes, templates and best practices for program governance and delivery.

**Required skills and experience**

* 5+ years managing enterprise software or ERP programs with external clients, with a track record of delivering multiple concurrent programs on time and within budget.
* Experience managing delivery against a contract or SOW: deliverables, milestones, acceptance and change control.
* Experience in Aerospace & Defense, government contracting, or another compliance-driven industry.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage client, partner and vendor stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable reporting to client executives.

**Desirable**

* SAP S/4HANA program experience.
* Familiarity with FAR/DFARS and A&D compliance requirements.

* Working knowledge of PM tools such as MS Project and Jira.

* Retirement plan

Experience:

* SAP S/4HANA: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager - Boston
jobs.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

**Strategic Program Manager (SPM) – Join Our World-Class Team at MISUMI Americas!**

As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at MISUMI Americas, you'll partner with leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches without sacrificing quality. Acting as a trusted advisor, you'll bring deep expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every stage — from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production.

You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment teams to scope, plan, and execute complex programs, ensuring products launch on time, within budget, and at the highest quality standards. Your ability to align internal teams with customer goals will be central to delivering consistent, measurable value across the full product lifecycle.

Beyond program execution, you'll play an active role in continuous improvement — identifying opportunities to refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that make MISUMI Americas an even stronger partner for its customers.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships to deliver high-quality customer experiences that drive long-term loyalty.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with pre- & post-sale teams to ensure on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Leverage your technical expertise in engineering and manufacturing alongside strong program management skills to identify risks early, develop risk mitigation plans, and manage changes to keep projects on track.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the program, providing valuable insights and guidance to both internal teams and customers to ensure alignment and clarity.
* Monitor and report program milestones making necessary adjustments to timelines and deliverables, to meet customer expectations and maintain high-quality standards.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Facilitate regular status meetings with customers and internal teams to clearly communicate requirements, timelines, and quality standards, ensuring alignment and proactively resolving any blockers.
* All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

**Desired Traits:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering.
* 5+ years of experience managing projects/ programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and high-volume manufacturing facilities.
* Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC Machining, 3D Printing, Injection Molding, Sheet Metal Fabrication, Die Casting, or Assembly.
* Customer-Facing Experience to lead complex, consultative technical sales engagements, leveraging operational expertise to drive success.
* Strong program management, risk management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines within a structured framework.
* Proficiency in standard program management tools and software used for tracking, communication, and reporting across distributed teams.
* Self-starter, with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving problems and building deep, meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrates a focus on process optimization, service enhancement, and driving customer success.
* Passionate about learning, building solutions, and tackling challenges.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with experience working across multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.

At MISUMI Americas you will be part of an innovative team that is redefining the future of manufacturing. If you’re excited by challenges, passionate about delivering customer success, and eager to continuously learn and grow, we want to hear from you!

### **Perks and Benefits**

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K plan
* Monthly Virtual Work stipend for things like food, internet, travel, pet care, health and wellness
* Parental leave programs
* Paid volunteer days
* Onboarding setup, including: standing desk, laptop, monitor, and chair, and a stipend for additional items such as headphones, blue light glasses, or any other ergonomic supplies you may want or need
* And much, much more!

Salary Range: $123,000 to $145,000 USD per year, depending upon experience

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Partner Program Manager
jobs.description:
**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

**About the job**

As we expand our partner ecosystem to support global growth targets, we are expanding our team to scale responsibly. We are seeking a versatile **Partner Program Manager** to drive an exceptional experience across our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. This balanced role bridges the gap between high-touch partner experience, strategic cross-functional project management, and advanced lifecycle automation. If you have a deep background in partnerships, an AI-forward mindset for process optimization, and hands-on experience with modern ecosystem toolsets, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our global network.

In this role, you won't just follow a static blueprint—you will help build it. We are seeking a highly proactive partner program manager to drive exceptional experiences for our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. You will take the lead on optimizing the end-to-end partner journey, managing cross-functional projects, and eliminating operational friction.

This position requires a "can-do" attitude and a passion for continuous improvement. You will be responsible for transforming manual workflows into automated, scalable systems, managing key vendor capabilities, and implementing strategic initiatives that directly unlock ecosystem revenue velocity.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* **Drive Program Modernization & Scale:** Act as an operational engine for the team, identifying process bottlenecks and proactively designing new ways to automate existing manual workflows.
* **Own Problem-Solving:** Step into complex challenges across the partner lifecycle and chart a clear path forward to build repeatable, programmatic solutions.
* **Optimize the Partner Experience:** Lead and refine core partner onboarding pathways, lifecycle touchpoints, and support workflows to deliver a seamless, world-class journey for external ecosystems.
* **Accelerate Partner Revenue Mechanics:** Build and execute operational frameworks that eliminate transaction friction, streamline incentive administration, and maximize partner-sourced revenue pipelines.
* **Manage Technology & Vendor Capabilities:** Serve as a strategic owner for key components of our partner tech stack and vendor relationships, ensuring our data models and tools are optimized for ecosystem scale rather than mere maintenance.
* **Orchestrate High-Touch Communications:** Develop and execute comprehensive partner engagement strategies, ensuring clear, accessible program documentation, impactful updates, and consistent enablement communications across all segments.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Project Execution:** Develop and run end-to-end project plans for new partner initiatives, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Tech teams to ensure alignment and timely milestone delivery.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* **Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered.
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in partner program or project management, partner management, strategy and operations, or a similar role within a fast-paced technology company.
* **The "Get-Stuff-Done" Mindset:** A proven track record of operating effectively in complex environments, turning ambiguous problems into plans, and delivering results without a rigid instructions script.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex cross-functional timelines, align diverse stakeholders, and drive accountability.
* **Communication & Content:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating complex program guidelines into clear, compelling partner assets, guides, and updates.

**Desired:**

* **Ecosystem Acumen:** Solid understanding of modern partner program structures, lifecycle methodologies, and experience working with SIs, ISVs, Resell, or Technology tracks.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.

**Zone Operating Model & Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance & Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM & Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

**CRM Data Quality & Pipeline Discipline**

* Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
* Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
* Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
* Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.

**Business Requirements Management**

* Collect, consolidate, and document zone-wide and country-specific business requirements.
* Assess alignment among country needs, zone priorities, and global standards, identifying opportunities for common solutions across countries.
* Coordinate zone-level prioritization and escalation of enhancement requests with country stakeholders.
* Coordinate review and approval of zone- and country-driven process changes.

**Exception & Change Control Management**

* Manage intake, triage, and documentation of country exception requests related to CRM processes, business rules, data standards, and operating procedures.
* Assess business impact, cross-country scalability, compliance considerations, and downstream reporting implications before escalating exceptions for approval.
* Maintain traceability of approved deviations and ensure they are reviewed periodically for continued relevance or harmonization back to the global standard.

**Zone & Country Readiness and Change Management**

* Coordinate rollout of CRM capabilities, governance initiatives, and business process changes across the assigned zone.
* Work with zone and country stakeholders to coordinate training, communication, and awareness activities.
* Monitor readiness across the zone and identify country-level gaps, dependencies, and support needs for new capabilities and transformations.
* Confirm country readiness against defined launch criteria and consolidate the results into a zone readiness view, including data readiness, business owner assignment, process documentation, training completion, and support model alignment.
* Coordinate post-launch stabilization with zone and country roles by tracking issue volume, adoption gaps, training needs, and open decisions

**Day in the Life: Data Analyst III**

The Data Analyst III position, reporting to the Manager of Data Services, is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned professional to play a pivotal role in executing Trinity's cutting-edge technology strategy! In the dynamic logistics industry, especially within a 3PL environment, data is absolutely essential. As a Data Analyst III, you will have the chance to work with modern tools like Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, and AWS, using your analytical expertise to deliver business value. Experience utilizing SQL and Power BI will be vital to the successful candidate in this role. Your contributions will directly impact Trinity's business units and users, and you'll have the rewarding opportunity to mentor and develop our Analyst I and Analyst II team members through guidance, code reviews, and coaching.

As part of a collaborative team, you will embrace an Agile approach to bring development stories to life, continuously enhancing our technology offerings. You will be instrumental in creating flexible data ingestion pipelines, ensuring right-time data delivery, and integrating both structured and unstructured data sets for in-depth analysis. Utilizing modern, resilient toolsets for data delivery, you will construct reporting applications, determine optimal implementation strategies, and engage in meaningful collaboration with both technology and business stakeholders. These key day-to-day functions will empower you to make a significant impact in our organization!

The role is grounded in our Company's Core Values:

* **Personal.Service.Excellence.** We share a passion for serving others and take extreme ownership of creating the best possible experience.

* **Make it Happen.** With integrity we are persistent in overcoming obstacles, delivering beyond expectations.

* **We Not Me.** Through listening and collaboration, we selflessly solve problems to create success.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Coordinate and develop data extracts, data analysis, and data delivery across multiple data sets and subsystems, including leading requirement definition with end users, prototyping, design, coding, testing, and deployment.

* Keep the department leader informed of the status of all objectives within span of control, where there are problems or concerns as well as strategies and solutions being taken to resolve them.

* Nurture, build, and maintain trusting, ethical, and influential relationships within the organization and with other team members.

* Contribute to the communication and adherence of the team to technology standards and architectural guidelines.

* Practice excellent planning and organization skills.

* Actively participate and contribute at various corporate meetings.

* Remain knowledgeable in the areas of market and industry trends relating to prevailing and emerging data analysis and delivery technologies.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Tools: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, Snowflake, data visualization tools (preferably Power BI), and data marts/data warehouse concepts.

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting-edge technology and deep cross-border expertise, we deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and content and brand protection.

As part of the Legal Operations team, you will also support our client's responses to law enforcement and privacy requests.

jobs.title: Business Analyst / Functional Tester (CMS-HIOS)
jobs.description:
### **About Pluribus Digital:**

Join us and do work that matters: use your skills to improve how your government serves the public! Pluribus Digital partners with our government customers to design, develop, and deliver useful and impactful digital products. We are a hands-on digital services consultancy – part technologists, part change agents, and all heart. We employ modern best practices in all that we do as we work to solve problems in public health, financial industry regulation, granting citizenship and asylum, and identity and access management.

### **Role Description**

As a **Business Analyst / Functional Tester**, you will play a key role in supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS), a mission-critical federal application supporting the regulation and oversight of the health insurance marketplace. This role focuses on Operations & Maintenance (O&M), production support, user support, and incremental enhancements across numerous business modules.

Working within an Agile delivery team, you will collaborate closely with CMS stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, testers, architects, and operations personnel to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and verify, through hands-on functional testing, that what the team delivers meets those requirements. You'll own the work from requirement to validated feature, writing user stories and acceptance criteria and then testing completed work before it reaches CMS stakeholders. You will also support incident analysis, defect resolution, enhancement requests, business process improvements, and documentation efforts that enable the continued success of the system.

### **What You Will Do**

#### **Requirements & Analysis**

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements from CMS stakeholders and business users.
* Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, business process documentation, workflow diagrams, and functional specifications.
* Analyze enhancement requests, production issues, and operational processes to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and user experience.
* Ensure requirements are complete, traceable, testable, and aligned with CMS objectives and governance standards.
* Maintain requirements and supporting documentation throughout the Agile delivery lifecycle.

#### **Manual & Functional Testing**

* Write and maintain test scenarios, test cases, and test data that trace directly to user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Test each story within the sprint and confirm it meets acceptance criteria before it is marked done.
* Log clear, reproducible defects with steps, expected vs. actual results, screenshots, and severity. Retest fixes and verify closure.
* Maintain a requirements traceability matrix and the test evidence that release and CMS governance reviews require.
* Do exploratory testing to find edge cases, usability problems, and gaps in requirements.
* Work with developers on defect triage and root cause, and with QA staff on test coverage and standards.

#### **Operations & Production Support**

* Support investigation and analysis of production issues, customer-reported defects, and operational questions.
* Collaborate with technical teams to reproduce issues, clarify expected system behavior, and document business impacts.
* Reproduce production issues in lower environments and confirm fixes before they are deployed.
* Assist with prioritization of defects and enhancement requests based on business value and operational needs.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities and recommend process or system improvements.
* Help maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, and user-facing documentation as system functionality evolves.

#### **Agile Delivery**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with Product Owners to refine and prioritize product backlogs.
* Ensure user stories contain sufficient business context and well-defined acceptance criteria.
* Prepare User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scripts, data, and environments. Guide CMS business users through UAT and track their findings to resolution.

#### **Stakeholder & Customer Engagement**

* Serve as a liaison between CMS business stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams.
* Facilitate requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.
* Communicate business needs, priorities, risks, and project status effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build collaborative relationships across multiple functional areas supporting the HIOS platform.

#### **Documentation & Process Improvement**

* Produce clear, concise documentation including business requirements, process flows, decision logs, release documentation, test plans and test results, and training materials.
* Assist with maintaining standard operating procedures and operational documentation.
* Recommend improvements to business processes, operational workflows, and support procedures based on data and stakeholder feedback.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a Moderate Risk Public Trust designation.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* 3–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting enterprise software applications.
* 2+ years of hands-on manual or functional testing of web-based enterprise applications, including writing test cases and running regression tests.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and managing functional and business requirements.
* Experience logging and managing defects through their full lifecycle in Jira, Azure DevOps, or a similar tool.
* Experience supporting Agile software delivery teams using Scrum or SAFe methodologies.
* Strong analytic

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the Voice of the Customer (VoC) program for Amazon Leo — a greenfield build spanning both consumer (B2C) and enterprise (B2B) customer segments. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role responsible for designing and operating the systems that transform customer feedback into actionable business intelligence, driving continuous improvement across the full customer journey from purchase through active service. This role is the architect of tools, systems, and customer connections — someone with a strong appetite for big data, technical depth to build and operate analytics infrastructure, and marketing acumen to translate customer signals into compelling narratives that drive action across the organization.  
You will set the strategy, build the operational infrastructure, and run the day-to-day program, working across product, engineering, customer service, field service, marketing, legal, and data science to close the loop on customer feedback at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end VoC program design and operations across B2C and B2B segments, including survey strategy, feedback touchpoint mapping, and escalation frameworks
* Partner with third-party vendors and internal engineering teams to integrate survey delivery across web, in-app, email, and field service channels
* Define and maintain VoC metrics, including CSAT, NPS, and operational proxy metrics, and establish escalation thresholds that trigger cross-functional action
* Build and operate real-time monitoring mechanisms, including flash reports, dashboards, and daily standup cadences, especially during high-intensity launch windows
* Lead cross-functional triage for customer-reported issues, routing signals to the appropriate owning teams (product, network engineering, hardware, CS, field service) and tracking resolution
* Design and operate business review cadences (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly) that connect customer feedback to leadership decision-making
* Collaborate with legal, privacy, and security teams to ensure survey and data handling practices meet compliance requirements
* Define go/no-go quality gates for new market launches using VoC-derived customer satisfaction and service reliability metrics
* Build and maintain the VoC analytics infrastructure in partnership with BI engineers, ensuring data from multiple feedback channels feeds a single source of truth

  
Export Control Requirement:  
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience working cross functionally across several teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience in survey design and datasets
* Experience building and operating customer feedback or VoC programs at scale

- Background in consumer electronics, connectivity services, or hardware-as-a-service products  

* Experience managing VoC programs across both consumer and enterprise customer segments
* Familiarity with AWS data and analytics services (QuickSight, S3, etc.)
* Experience in a launch or early commercial stage environment; comfort operating under ambiguity with high urgency
* Track record of building programs from scratch without inherited infrastructure or playbooks

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.description:
**Location:** Chantilly, VA  
**Security Clearance:** Active TS or higher [Required]  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Target Salary Range\*:**$110,000 - $160,000

* *This represents the potential salary range for this position depending on education level, years of experience and/or certifications in addition to other position specific requirements which may impact salary*

**Position Overview:**
======================

Amatriot is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst to support a Cyber Technical Analysis Unit in analyzing cyber intrusion activity, digital communications, and host/network forensic artifacts in support of DoJ mission operations.

This role is focused on cyber threat analysis, intrusion investigation, host-based forensic analysis, network traffic analysis, and attribution support within a highly sensitive operational environment.

The ideal candidate will possess experience analyzing Splunk data, conducting host and network forensic analysis, and utilizing industry-standard forensic and cyber analysis tools to identify malicious activity, recover artifacts, and support investigative operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Cyber Threat Analysis and Intrusion Investigation**

* Process, evaluate, and analyze digital network communications and cyber threat data to identify malicious activity and support investigative operations.
* Conduct cyber intrusion investigations and end-to-end kill chain analysis across host and network environments.
* Correlate digital artifacts, including IP addresses, URLs, malware indicators, system logs, and user activity across multiple data sources to support attribution and investigative lead generation.
* Support attribution and operational analysis by correlating threat indicators and investigative data.

### **Host-Based Forensic Analysis**

* Perform host-based forensic analysis leveraging Splunk and standard forensic toolsets to identify indicators of compromise, attacker activity, persistence mechanisms, and unauthorized access.
* Analyze encrypted and plaintext credentials, registry artifacts, rootkit activity, command-line execution, and other system-level forensic evidence.
* Recover artifacts to support investigative operations.

### **Network Traffic Analysis**

* Analyze packet capture and NetFlow data to identify malicious communications, software usage, command execution, credential activity, and network-based indicators of compromise.

### **Reporting, Process Development, and Quality Assurance**

* Draft detailed technical reports and analytical findings based on cyber investigations.
* Participate in internal review and quality assurance processes.
* Support development and refinement of cyber analysis processes, CONOPS, SOPs, and investigative methodologies.
* Provide operational updates and analytical findings to leadership and investigative stakeholders.

### **Threat Research and Mission Collaboration**

* Conduct open-source and intelligence community research to maintain awareness of emerging cyber threats, malware trends, and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Collaborate with internal teams and mission partners across the intelligence community to support tactical and strategic cyber operations.

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Education**

* BS/BA degree with 5+ years of relevant experience, or 9 years of relevant experience with no degree.
* Advanced certifications, specialized training, or equivalent hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of years of experience.

### **Experience**

* Experience performing host-based forensic analysis utilizing Splunk.
* Experience analyzing network traffic, packet capture, and NetFlow data.
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard forensic tools such as:
  + Splunk
  + EnCase
  + Magnet AXIOM
  + X-Ways Forensics
* Experience correlating threat indicators and investigative data to support attribution and operational analysis.

### **Skills**

* Understanding of cyber intrusion methodologies, attacker kill chains, malware behavior, and forensic artifact analysis.

### **Clearance**

* Active Top Secret clearance required, with willingness and ability to obtain a Counterintelligence Polygraph.

* Develops sustainability plans for initiatives supported by time‑limited philanthropic or federal resources, budget proposals and multi‑year investment plans that prioritize system coherence, educator capacity, and equitable literacy outcomes.
* Leads the review and feedback cycles for LEA literacy plans, providing differentiated support and ensuring alignment to state policy expectations.
* Coordinates with School Library Media Specialists on access to high‑quality texts, digital resources, and knowledge‑building materials to strengthen statewide literacy ecosystems and promote statewide initiatives that enhance library media programming.
* Oversees analysis of literacy data, including K–3 screening data, Student Reading Improvement Plan (SRIP) implementation, World Class Instructional Design and Assessment (WIDA) literacy domains, Kindergarten Readiness Assessment (KRA), and Maryland Comprehensive Assessment Program / Maryland System of Testing Academic Readiness (MCAP / MSTAR) ELA.

jobs.description:
*Turn warehouse data into the decisions that keep high-tech supply chains moving.* ***This position is based in Virginia and is NOT REMOTE***

The Dulles corridor runs on data. From the data centers of Loudoun County to the air cargo moving through Dulles Airport, this region is where logistics and technology meet, and this role sits right at that intersection.

At Arnoff, our partner Dulles facility supports a forward stocking location for a leading technology customer, where the right part in the right place at the right time really matters. We are looking for a Warehouse Data Analyst who loves clean numbers, sharp reports, and finding the story hiding in a spreadsheet. You will be the person that we rely on to know exactly what is on hand, what shipped, and how we are performing.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE

* **Real impact, fast. Your reports go straight to program managers, supervisors, and Finance, and they drive daily decisions, customer scorecards, and billing.**
* **Room to build.** We want recurring reports to be automated. If you like that automation, you will have a real playground to put it to work.
* **Be the go-to person.** You will serve as Arnoff's representative and main point of contact at the facility, and you will train teammates on our reports and systems.
* **Learn the whole operation.** You will get hands-on with the warehouse floor so your analysis is grounded in how the work actually happens, which is great experience for a career in supply chain analytics or program management. **Inventory experience preferred in a manufacturing setting.**
* **A schedule that fits life.** Weekday daytime hours with overtime eligibility, in a location that is easy to reach from Loudoun, western Fairfax, and the Route 28 corridor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the reporting rhythm

* Run and distribute assigned reports, including on-hand inventory and requested transactional reports.
* Run the shipment and location reports that set the Supervisor up for the day.
* Compile and enter milestone data for the daily milk run.
* Prepare weekly and monthly cycle count reports for the Program Manager.

Power the numbers that matter

* Build the data behind scorecard updates and KPI, SLA, volume, and spend reporting.
* Provide billing data to the Program Manager and Finance every billing cycle.
* Supply controllable-error data to support warehouse performance reviews.
* Spot data discrepancies and flag them to the Supervisor for correction.

Make it better

* Automate recurring reports and keep report documentation current.
* Train staff on reports and system use.
* Serve as Arnoff's main point of contact at the facility and support project management as needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

* A bachelor's degree in analytics, supply chain, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years in reporting or analytics, ideally in warehousing or logistics.
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, lookups). Power BI or Tableau is a big plus.
* Experience pulling and reconciling data from existing systems.
* A working understanding of inventory concepts like shrinkage, cycle counts, and on-hand buckets.
* Clear, accurate writing that turns findings into actionable insights.

Bonus points if you have military logistics, supply, or 3PL experience, or if you can't leave a broken formula alone.

**Location**

**On-site in Dulles, VA, close to Route 28, the Dulles Toll Road, and Washington Dulles International Airport ( no relocation opportunities available)**

Schedule

Weekdays, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (40 hours, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch). No nights, no weekends.

Hourly, overtime-eligible (non-exempt)

**$32 - $36 per Hour**

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program

**Location:** Washington, DC, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-22

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Project Analyst

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 25% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** None

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** Secret

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

As an **Associate Program Analyst**, the candidate will support Test and Evaluation (T&E) of Foreign Military Sales (FMS) AEGIS surface ships and weapons systems for Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Mission Systems [formerly PEO IWS] at the Navy Yard in Washington, DC. Oversees and manages the operational aspects of ongoing projects and serves as liaison between project management and planning, project team, and line management. Reviews status of projects and budgets; manages schedules and prepares status reports. Assesses project issues and develops resolutions to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals and objectives. Develops mechanisms for monitoring project progress and for intervention and problem solving with project managers, line managers, and clients.

Your work will contribute to the successful at-sea testing of new construction and modernized AEGIS combat systems and ships for various US Navy International Partners. Your work will include understanding system capabilities; identifying requirements for at-sea testing; translating capabilities and test requirements to Test Objectives; using the Planning, Execution, Analysis, and Reporting (PEAR) process to develop test scenarios to evaluate Test Objectives; defining and validating resources needed to meet test scenario requirements; advising the test execution team during scenario execution; and ensuring data collection and analysis plans support reporting requirements. You will provide program office administrative and engineering support in the development of FMS cases. This project will include working on a team with senior engineers and program office personnel.

Support roles will include planning and delivering multi agency meetings to include presentation material, overall coordination, and tracking and closing action associated from the meetings. You will be required to maintain Confluence and Jira Project planning material. Assistance will be given to the program office representative to create and promulgate budgeting material. Prior US Navy or military experience is preferable ,but not required as self starters can be very effective in the job, so a lack of USN or military background should not discourage from applying.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline (Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field); In lieu of a technical degree, a minimum of 4 years of relevant U.S. Navy technical experience is required and acceptable.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information into clear test documentation and requirements.
* The position requires occasional travel to FMS countries such as Japan, South Korea, Australia or Spain to visit US test ranges or warfare centers.
* Ability to obtain an Interim Secret clearance or currently hold an active Secret clearance.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Relevant experience includes Navy ratings such as Fire Controlman (FC), Electronics Technician (ET), AEGIS Display Technician (ADTT), Operations Specialist (with AEGIS console experience), or other roles directly supporting AEGIS Combat Systems or shipboard combat system operations.
* Prior US Navy or military experience is preferable ,but not required as self starters can be very effective in the job, so a lack of USN or military background should not discourage from applying.
* Previous hands-on experience with the AEGIS Weapon System, either aboard ship or in a test, training, or integration environment.
* Technical background in combat systems, fire control, radar systems, electronic warfare, or naval systems integration.
* Familiarity with Test & Evaluation processes such as test planning, scenario development, data analysis, or operational testing.
* Experience using JIRA and Confluence for project or test management.
* Understanding of DoD acquisition processes or prior experience supporting NAVSEA, PEO IWS, or PAE Mission Systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, test officers, and program office personnel.

Target salary range: $40,001 - $80,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

An exciting opportunity awaits you as **Train Overhaul Project Manager** in our Rolling Stock department. The Train Overhaul Project Manager (internally known as R Exam Project Manager) will manage all aspects of the R exam overhaul and e320 major programmes for Eurostar. This requires management and coordination of all internal and external work streams and the residual work required to complete R exams including any depot modifications required within the agreed project timescales. The role will also lead and support other Engineering projects as required.

This is a **permanent** role is based on site at our **Temple Mills depot in Leyton**. Hybrid working is available, with the expectation you attend site 4 days per week.

**The close date for this role is 9AM on Monday, 9 November 2026**. Candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible; Eurostar reserves the right to contact candidates before close date and to close the role earlier if suitable candidates are identified.

*Internal use only: Grade F travel services 4-5.*

 **Requirements**

**We’re looking for someone to:**

* Lead the delivery of the R Exam overhaul programme, ensuring milestones are achieved safely, on time, and to the required quality standards.
* Manage and coordinate multiple internal and external project workstreams, aligning activities across Engineering, Fleet Planning, Production, Quality, Procurement, and supplier organisations.
* Monitor fleet maintenance schedules and running kilometre targets, ensuring R Exams are planned and delivered within vehicle maintenance requirements.
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks, implementing mitigation plans and escalating issues appropriately to senior stakeholders.
* Chair project governance and review meetings, providing clear progress updates and driving actions to resolve delays, quality concerns, and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Siemens and other suppliers to oversee contractual deliverables, material readiness, quality performance, and supplier compliance throughout the programme lifecycle.
* Support the development of future maintenance and overhaul strategies, including optimisation initiatives to improve fleet availability, reliability, and operational performance.
* Develop business cases, manage project budgets and reporting activities, and maintain effective stakeholder engagement across the UK and mainland Europe.

**You'll need...**

* Proven project management experience delivering complex engineering or rolling stock projects from planning through to implementation.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build effective relationships across multiple organisations.
* Experience managing project risks, dependencies, and change activities within a safety-critical or regulated environment.
* Good understanding of engineering governance, legislation, industry standards, and safety management principles.
* Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, contractors, and technical specialists to deliver project objectives.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills, with experience using project management tools and software to track progress and performance.
* Knowledge of rolling stock maintenance, train operations, fleet management, or rail engineering environments would be advantageous.
* Educated to HNC, HND, Degree level, or equivalent in Engineering, Project Management, or a related discipline; IOSH and/or risk management qualifications would be desirable.

  
**Benefits**

We’re constantly working to create a bright future for our company and our colleagues. That’s why we offer a wide range of brilliant benefits, including:

* Travel benefits that can be used for both work and play including 75% off underground network from Day 1
* Competitive defined benefit pension scheme
* Free Eurostar tickets
* Discounted Eurostar tickets for friends and family
* Ongoing training and development
* Free, confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme
* Peer-to-Peer support from trained Mental Health First Aiders/Personne de Confiance
* Lots of other exclusive deals, discounts and perks

A whole new platform for your career - If you think you’ve got what it takes to help us make Eurostar bigger and better than ever before then we’d love to hear from you.

*At Eurostar we believe in giving everyone an equal chance. We actively encourage applications from talented individuals regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or belief, marital status, whether you’re pregnant or on maternity leave.*

*Your individuality is your strength, and we want a diverse team that reflects the world we live in.*
