jobs.description:
**Hello. We’re Teya.**

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

**Teya exists to change that.**

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

**Senior Data Analyst – Enterprise Risk**
=========================================

**The role**
------------

Teya is building its Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) and strengthening how risk information is brought together, analysed and reported across the business.

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in turning risk data into reliable measures, meaningful insights and actionable reporting. You'll work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and stakeholders across Credit, Fraud, AML, People, IT, Operations and Finance to understand the risks facing the business, identify the right data to monitor them, and develop effective reporting and early-warning capabilities.

This is a business-facing analytical role. Understanding risk, working effectively with risk owners and translating their requirements into practical data solutions will be just as important as your technical skills. You'll help ensure key risk indicators (KRIs) are meaningful, data is reliable, thresholds are appropriately informed by analysis, and reporting supports better risk oversight and decision-making.

You'll also help modernise how risk reporting is produced, using AI models and workflow automation to bring together internal data and relevant external information, identify emerging issues and reduce manual effort. The focus is on practical application, with robust validation, traceability and human oversight.

This is an opportunity to combine risk expertise, analytical problem-solving and emerging AI capabilities to help shape how a growing fintech business identifies, monitors and manages risk.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Develop risk data and reporting:** Identify and map relevant data sources, using tools such as Snowflake to build repeatable datasets for KRIs across operational, credit, fraud, AML, people, capital, liquidity and other risk categories.
* **Partner with risk stakeholders:** Work closely with the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and risk owners across the business to understand their priorities, clarify reporting requirements and translate risk management needs into practical analytical solutions.
* **Analyse and monitor risk indicators:** Use SQL and Python to investigate trends, test assumptions, identify anomalies and understand changes in risk exposure. Help risk owners interpret findings and determine where further investigation or action may be needed.
* **Support KRI definitions and thresholds:** Work with risk stakeholders to validate indicator definitions, assess data quality and analyse historical and current performance to inform threshold calibration. Help ensure indicators provide meaningful insight into the risks they are intended to monitor.
* **Build dashboards and management reporting:** Develop clear, accessible dashboards using Tableau, Power BI or similar tools, supporting monthly ERMF reporting and management oversight.
* **Automate risk reporting with AI:** Build and improve AI-enabled workflows that bring together internal data and relevant external signals, including regulatory updates, market developments, news and emerging threats. Help generate evidence-based reporting drafts for review by the Head of Enterprise & Operational Risk and CRO.
* **Develop early-warning capabilities:** Help design and test approaches to monitor KRI movements and operational data throughout the month, highlighting unusual patterns and potential emerging risks with clear supporting evidence for investigation.
* **Support risk technology and integration:** Translate ERMF and reporting requirements into practical data, integration and workflow specifications for Teya's governance, risk and compliance (GRC) solution, partnering with Risk, Data and Technology colleagues on implementation.
* **Improve data quality and governance:** Document data sources, definitions, lineage, refresh frequencies, validation checks and limitations to ensure reporting is consistent, explainable and reliable.
* **Drive continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, improve analytical processes and strengthen how risk information is used across the business.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Experience in a data analytics, risk analytics or similar analytical role within a risk function, ideally covering enterprise, operational, credit, fraud or financial crime risk.
* A practical understanding of how risk is identified, assessed and monitored, including how risk appetite, controls, risk drivers, KRIs and thresholds connect.
* Strong business partnering skills, with the ability to work closely with risk owners and non-technical stakeholders, understand their needs and translate them into meaningful analysis, reporting and monitoring solutions.

The role will help define how the Office of the CIO operates in BAU, including its governance structure, accountabilities, decision rights, risk and control processes, management information, committee framework and escalation routes.

jobs.title: Site Security Manager
jobs.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------

Hadrian's Physical Security team protects the people, factories and export-controlled work behind Hadrian's growth. As we open new factories and bring on new teams, every site needs a security leader on the ground, and the program needs people who help build it across all of our sites.

You will own security at our Torrance campus and be hands on every day: managing the contract security team, walking the site, and acting as the first call for any security risk. This is more than a walk-the-floor role. You'll also own a program area across every Hadrian site, such as investigations, workplace violence prevention, vendor management or security training, and help build a physical security program that keeps pace with the business. You'll partner with site leadership, Facilities, EH&S, People and the Facility Security Officer, and report to the Director of Physical Security. This is an on-site role in Torrance, CA.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Manage the contract security vendor at the site: set post orders and patrol plans, check the work against them, and hold the vendor to the contract.
* Walk the site regularly, find gaps in doors, openings and day-to-day security practice, rank them, and get them fixed.
* Lead the response to security incidents and site events as the first security leader on scene, and document them clearly.
* Keep site controls in place, including badge access, visitor management, key control, contractor escorts and controlled areas, in partnership with the Facility Security Officer.
* Build working relationships with local law enforcement, fire and other emergency services, and partner with site leadership, Facilities, EH&S and People.
* Own a program area across every Hadrian site, such as investigations, workplace violence prevention, vendor management, budget or security training.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years in corporate, industrial or government security, including time leading a site or a contract security team.
* Experience building or improving a security program, not only running a post or a site.
* Hands-on experience with access control, video and visitor management systems.
* Sound incident judgment and clear writing: incident reports, findings and post orders others can act on.
* Comfort working on a production floor and responding after hours when needed.
* Ability to hold vendors to a high standard while keeping a strong working relationship.

**What Will Set You Apart**
---------------------------

* Background in intelligence, investigations, workplace violence prevention or security training.
* Aerospace, defense or manufacturing experience.
* Experience with export-controlled or other controlled environments.
* Experience with California workplace violence prevention requirements (SB 553).
* PSP or CPP certification.

**Benefits for Full-time Employees**
------------------------------------

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
    
  401k
* Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

**ITAR Requirements**
---------------------

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

**Use of AI in hiring**

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

  

Motive is seeking a Senior Security Technical Program Manager to drive execution of the Security & Privacy Roadmap and other high-priority security risk-reduction programs. You will turn complex security and privacy goals into sequenced, measurable plans; align Security, Product, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, and business partners; and make risks, dependencies, resourcing needs, and decisions visible to executives. You will play a central role in quarterly security planning and in preparing clear, evidence-based, board-ready updates.This role is well suited to a hands-on program leader who can move between technical detail and executive narrative—and who measures success by durable risk reduction and shipped outcomes, not activity alone.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Own roadmap execution:** Maintain the integrated Security & Privacy Roadmap from intake and prioritization through delivery and operational handoff. Clarify scope, accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and success measures across concurrent initiatives.
* **Drive risk-reduction programs:** Lead cross-functional execution of major security programs, which may include identity and access management, authorization, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection and retention, privacy controls, and security assurance. Keep work tied to explicit risks and customer or business outcomes.
* **Lead quarterly planning:** Coordinate planning inputs, capacity and sequencing discussions, prioritization trade-offs, and commitments. Surface gaps early, distinguish committed work from aspirational work, and bring options and recommendations to decision-makers.
* **Establish operating rigor:** Run effective program reviews and maintain concise plans, RAID logs, decision records, and dashboards. Track leading indicators and delivery milestones; escalate blockers with clear impact, owner, and recommended next step.
* **Prepare executive and board materials:** Develop accurate, board-ready narratives and presentations that explain the risk, why it matters, progress against commitments, measurable outcomes, material changes, and decisions or investments required. Validate claims and metrics with accountable teams.
* **Build strong partnerships:** Align technical and nontechnical stakeholders, facilitate decisions when priorities conflict, and communicate with clarity at levels ranging from engineers to senior executives.
* **Improve the system:** Identify recurring delivery, governance, or measurement gaps and improve the security program operating model so teams can execute predictably and demonstrate control effectiveness.

### **What We're Looking For:**

* 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, with meaningful experience in cybersecurity, product security, privacy, or a closely related risk-management domain.
* A track record of delivering multi-team programs across engineering and business functions, including work with senior leaders and teams that do not report to you.
* Strong program-management fundamentals: integrated plans, dependency and critical-path management, risk and issue resolution, capacity planning, change control, and outcome-based reporting.
* Ability to understand security architecture and control objectives well enough to ask precise questions, identify delivery and risk gaps, and translate technical details into business impact—without needing to be the hands-on implementer.
* Excellent executive writing and presentation skills; experience producing concise leadership updates or board-level materials grounded in verified evidence.

------------

At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people, “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity.

**About the Information Service and Technology (IST) Department****:** Connecting our community and local government through innovative, accessible technology solutions.

* **Customers:** Enable departments through partnerships, responsiveness, and innovation; prioritizing their needs and fulfilling their expectations.
* **Solutions:** Be Innovative Business Leaders who identify opportunities early and apply technology to drive better, faster public services.

**Culture:** Cultivate leadership at all levels to drive IST’s success while advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. In addition to a full benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Pension/Retirement, deferred compensation, and flexible spending accounts, we offer our employees:

* Hybrid (telework/onsite) work schedules.
* Options for Alternative Work Schedules (such as 4-5/9’s).
* A culture of public service collaboration and work/life balance.
* Training and career development opportunities.
* County benefits such as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Tuition Assistance Program (TAP).

  
**Remote Work Options:** The IST Department has embraced a hybrid work schedule that recognizes some duties of this position may be performed remotely. Candidates must be able to work**a minimum of** **three (3) days per week in the office**and report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule.  
  

**About the Project Management Office Team:** Our team provides centralized IT project management for technology-related projects across all County departments. We use standard project management principles, processes, tools, and software to ensure consistent project delivery approach and success.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

**We currently have one (1) full-time vacancy for a Senior IT Project Manager (County Classification: Senior Systems Engineer) in the Project Management Office (PMO) of the Information Services and Technology (IST) department.** The primary function of this assignment is senior-level IT project management, not hands-on systems engineering.

This is an opportunity for a Senior IT Project Manager to manage and deliver significant IT projects and contribute to how technology projects are delivered across Marin County, while supporting innovation, collaboration, and improved public outcomes.

Reporting to the IT Manager of PMO, the Senior IT Project Manager works with a team of IT professionals to manage health and delivery of IT projects across all methodologies (agile, hybrid, waterfall) with varied technology applications. They are responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle, stakeholders, project documentation, serve as technical specialists, operate independently with minimal supervision and provide mentorship to junior team members when needed. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO Program through developing, updating and documenting project management policies, standards and guidelines to align with organizational goals.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

The ideal candidate has senior project management experience and has previously served in a project management office. This individual has managed the implementation of IT projects independently, throughout the project lifecycle, across all project methodologies, with a proven track record of successful implementations. They possess strong knowledge of project management and technical understanding to effectively lead technology projects, collaborate with technical teams, evaluate risks and dependencies, and communicate technical considerations to business stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills are expected for cross functional collaboration with stakeholders across the organization and external parties.

* Proficient and have a proven track record in delivering projects on time and on budget.
* Mentoring project management professionals in a team environment.
* Building collaborative partnerships across business and technical teams.
* Experience of technology (including system design, integration, testing, deployment, lifecycle management, compliance and vendor management).
* Analyzing client needs and managing project plan and stakeholder alignment.
* Adaptable with strong problem-solving mindset to maintain project critical path, with escalations as appropriate.
* Engagement and negotiation with external vendors/consultants to meet business requirements (including contract construction and budget tracking).
* Providing reports and conducting presentations for project stakeholders.
* Using data, metrics, and dashboards to support project decision-making.
* Promoting innovation and modern service delivery practice to support collaboration and productivity in project management practices.
* Staying current and updated with Project Management Institute (PMI) best practices and making recommendations regarding advancements and changes.

  
Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or related credentials

At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

**Innovation**

* Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
* Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
* Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

**Business Intelligence**

* Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

**Data Management**

* Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
* Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

**Our ideal candidate will have:**

* Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
* Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
* Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
* At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
* At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
* At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
* At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
* At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
* At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. * Demonstrate familiarity with CI indicators, national-level intelligence requirements, and analytical products, processes, and standards

* Identify and assess intelligence threats through name trace activities and screening and vetting using classified research and IC tools and databases
* Articulate foreign intelligence entity (FIE) trends, tradecraft, and activities targeting Department of Defense equities
* Produce and disseminate complex findings concisely and effectively through internal analysis and finished intelligence (FINTEL), in written, oral, and other media formats, to inform decision-makers at organizational levels and/or for broader IC and inter-agency audiences
* Apply analytical tradecraft consistent with Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs) 203 and 206 to all product lines, including CI threat assessments, CI notes, intelgraphics, briefing slides, and other requested products
* Answer routine requests for information within designated suspense timelines
* Support internal reviews and QA/QC for team production
* Submit report evaluations to the greater IC
* Maintain internal databases and records IAW local policy
* Remain compliant with current policies, regulations, and training
* Perform other relevant duties, as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Five (5) years of experience working with a Federal Government organization
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* TS/SCI clearance required

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Formal all-source or CI analyst training
* Five (5) years of experience working within the IC
* Experience with supporting CI missions or organizations
* Familiarity with IC-style writing
* Working knowledge of current IC tools and databases (within the last three (3) years)
* Developed, published, and disseminated national-level FINTEL products (within the last three (3) years)

new_jobs.title: Site Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future**
======================================

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------

Hadrian's Physical Security team protects the people, factories and export-controlled work behind Hadrian's growth. As we open new factories and bring on new teams, every site needs a security leader on the ground, and the program needs people who help build it across all of our sites.

You will own security at our Torrance campus and be hands on every day: managing the contract security team, walking the site, and acting as the first call for any security risk. This is more than a walk-the-floor role. You'll also own a program area across every Hadrian site, such as investigations, workplace violence prevention, vendor management or security training, and help build a physical security program that keeps pace with the business. You'll partner with site leadership, Facilities, EH&S, People and the Facility Security Officer, and report to the Director of Physical Security. This is an on-site role in Torrance, CA.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Manage the contract security vendor at the site: set post orders and patrol plans, check the work against them, and hold the vendor to the contract.
* Walk the site regularly, find gaps in doors, openings and day-to-day security practice, rank them, and get them fixed.
* Lead the response to security incidents and site events as the first security leader on scene, and document them clearly.
* Keep site controls in place, including badge access, visitor management, key control, contractor escorts and controlled areas, in partnership with the Facility Security Officer.

* Own a program area across every Hadrian site, such as investigations, workplace violence prevention, vendor management, budget or security training.

--------------------------

* 5+ years in corporate, industrial or government security, including time leading a site or a contract security team.
* Experience building or improving a security program, not only running a post or a site.
* Hands-on experience with access control, video and visitor management systems.
* Sound incident judgment and clear writing: incident reports, findings and post orders others can act on.
* Comfort working on a production floor and responding after hours when needed.
* Ability to hold vendors to a high standard while keeping a strong working relationship.

**What Will Set You Apart**
---------------------------

* Background in intelligence, investigations, workplace violence prevention or security training.
* Aerospace, defense or manufacturing experience.
* Experience with export-controlled or other controlled environments.
* Experience with California workplace violence prevention requirements (SB 553).
* PSP or CPP certification.

  401k

* Flexible vacation policy
* Equity

These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. * Execute comprehensive risk assessments for employment and people data privacy risks for projects and products involving people data at the company
* Contribute to the ongoing design and maturity of our operations to reinforce industry-leading second line of defense employment privacy risk assessment
* Collaborate with key Legal, Privacy and HR business program and product owners to build understanding and thought partnership for people data risks, including consulting on longer-term product strategy of the teams and respective leadership
* Manage cross-functional dependencies, risks, and changes effectively by optimizing scope, schedule, and resources accordingly
* Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions, including reducing the manual efforts through automation
* Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, and ensure people compliance is not compromised
* Manage relationships both internal and external to the Meta People organization
* Communicate clearly and build alignment with stakeholders across teams to drive program outcomes, and team player attitude with a bias to action

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in implementing and supporting a comprehensive risk assessment program involving security, privacy, and/or employment compliance

* Experience conducting or overseeing privacy risk assessments or data protection impact assessments for workforce or HR data systems
* Experience partnering with Legal, Employment Law, or HR functions to navigate complex data privacy requirements

* Have working knowledge or the willingness to quickly learn the content and requirements of various employment laws, regulations, industry guidance, and company compliance policies
* Experience maintaining open, candid, and trusting work relationships with both product and engineering teams and with legal partners

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated skills in using AI tools, applications, or skills to monitor and inform operational health and business priorities
* Advanced degree in AI or security
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Technical background including depth and breadth of knowledge of AI systems, infrastructure or products
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Relevant privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM
* Experience working directly with people analytics, HR technology, or workforce intelligence platforms to assess data flows and privacy controls
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous regulatory or policy requirements into structured program deliverables and measurable outcomes
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with global employee data privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, or equivalent frameworks governing workforce data

new_jobs.description:
**Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?**

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Audience Business Analyst**

**San Mateo, CA (Collab)**

In this role you will be an analyst on SIE's Growth, Media, and Omnichannel Marketing team; specifically, as a part of the Audience, Infrastructure, and Measurement (AIM) team. You will play a vital role in shaping and evolving the way we communicate with our consumers. AIM Analysts bring a diverse range of expertise, spanning SQL development and audience strategy to product leadership and process optimization. While AIM analysts have clear areas of expertise, every member of the team has the opportunity to learn and grow new skills outside of their specialty by contributing to all areas of AIM.

  

We are looking to fill a new Audience Business Analyst role on the AIM team, specializing in audience strategy, operations, and activation for our Live Service business. You will further enable our global marketing organization to use our first party data to put the customer first in all our marketing communications. Together as gamer and customer experience advocates, we can show how PlayStation is truly the Best Place to Play!

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with marketing and agency partners across all marketing regions as the subject matter expert on our ecosystem of data to create custom segments and support campaign executions supporting player acquisition, ongoing engagement, and retention
* Advise partners on campaigns, using data-based insights from AIM, marketing analytics, data science models, and consumer research
* Work as part of our AIM SCRUM team to deliver value to audience activation, while also analyzing and employing operational optimizations that bring our operations to scale across all our owned and paid marketing channels
* Manage ad-hoc and automated customer lists to power PlayStation's digital marketing channels globally
* Ensure the efficient and successful delivery of all customer segments to global marketing platforms
* Partner with Martech product teams to translate business needs into actionable requirements and feature enhancements for marketing platforms.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with a diverse group of established partners including marketing, product/engineering teams, and agencies across different regions and cultures
* Experience with working with a variety of marketing platforms and channels, including but not limited to email, paid media, and custom tools
* Experience working with martech/adtech platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, DMPs, Publisher and Social Partners, etc)
* Executed analysis projects related to lifecycle marketing, targeting segmentation strategies, cohort analysis and tracking, churn prevention, A/B and multivariate tests, and reporting dashboard design and development
* SQL programming experience required
* 3 years' experience working with relational databases
* 5 years' marketing operations experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Well-spoken with strong presentation-making skills that effectively present data in a compelling way, both verbal and written, to influence partner strategy
* Demonstrates understanding of analytical approaches—can set up clean testing frameworks for clear and meaningful measurement reporting downstream
* Passionate about gaming and video game culture
* Experienced with BI visualization tools such as Domo and Tableau
* You are an analytical problem solver who is data driven, with a can-do attitude and flexibility to accommodate evolving business needs
* You thrive in a collaborative work environment and excel under pressure, with experience working on complex, international, large-scale, time-critical projects
* You are flexible and versatile in nature, able to overcome challenges while maintaining a positive attitude
* You are willing to roll up your sleeves to take on tasks with the team

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

*Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.*

*We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.*

*Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*
